name: Inaka de Katekyo
source:
The little lady having no prior knowledge of sexual matters is given a naughty lesson.

A college student spends his first summer in the countryside. While having difficulty looking for a suitable part-time job in the neighbourhood, he discovers a private tutor advertisement. He quickly gets accepted when he gives a call asking about the position.

To his surprise, he is welcomed into a splendid spacious home, where he begins to tutor a lovely little lady. They get along splendidly as the days pass. Eyeing on her bosom, coming in contact, and finally giving the long-awaited kiss...

"Senpai, I want to learn about sex education too!"

The routine study sessions are ignored, and the naughty lessons are born.

[Translated from [url=https://www.babel-soft.com/babel40.html]Babel[/url]]
translation:
毫无性知识的小女士受到了调皮的教训。

一名大学生在乡村度过了他的第一个夏天。当他在附近寻找合适的兼职工作时遇到困难，他发现了一则私人家教的广告。当他打电话询问这个职位时，很快就被接受了。

令他惊讶的是，他被欢迎进入一个华丽宽敞的家，在那里他开始辅导一位可爱的小女士。日子一天天过去，他们相处得很好。目光注视着她的胸膛，接触着，终于给予了期待已久的吻……

“学长，我也想学性教育！”

例行的学习课程被忽视，顽皮的课程就这样诞生了。
